test_name: Mark-list key signatures: a key change, a transposed passage, an enharmonic pair, a system start and a missing key (session 30)
description: cnb:keysig-style 'marks draws the cnb:keysig-marks entry for the score's key. m1 C major (two columns of noteheads, a double notehead on c'' one column apart, a hollow head, a bar), m2 D major by \transpose c d of a passage in C, m3 C major again with no cancelling naturals, m4 F sharp major (sharps) and m5 G flat major (flats), one set of pitch classes with two entries, m6 G flat's signature repeated at the second system's start, m7 D sharp major, which the table lacks: no signature (the engine warns). Widths are staff spaces, from the harvest's control-point hulls.

assertions._comment: === SECTION 1: ONE SIGNATURE PER KEY, NONE FOR THE CANCELLATION OR THE MISSING KEY ===

assertions.description: Six signatures are drawn (m1-m6): the KeyCancellation at m3 draws nothing, and D sharp major (m7) has no entry
D sharp major is not in the table: no signature, no fallback to the scale stack

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: C MAJOR, ITS DOUBLE NOTEHEAD, AND C AGAIN AFTER D ===

assertions.description: C major's two columns of 1.0-wide heads span 2.0 (the double notehead's heads one column apart)
C major after D major draws C's own entry and no naturals: the same width and height as m1's

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: THE TRANSPOSED PASSAGE TAKES D MAJOR'S ENTRY ===

assertions.description: \transpose c d of a C-major passage draws D major's entry (heads at 10 and 14, bar 8-16), not C's

assertions._comment: === SECTION 4: F SHARP AND G FLAT MAJOR ARE TOLD APART BY SPELLING ===

assertions.description: F sharp major draws its sharps entry
G flat major (the same pitch classes) draws its own flats entry, not F sharp's

assertions._comment: === SECTION 5: THE SIGNATURE REPEATED AT THE SECOND SYSTEM'S START ===

assertions.description: The second system opens with G flat major's signature, as m5 drew it
Every note renders, the missing key's measure included
D sharp major's first note renders without a signature
